name: cc-resources
description: TutanDev's Claude Code plugins and resources

plugins.name: dmf
plugins.description: Domain Modeling Made Functional in C# for any codebase: domain discovery, type-driven modeling, Result-based workflow pipelines, DTOs and persistence, with DMF and functional-style reviewers, and hooks that hold C# design, implementation and review to them and log every reviewer run.

plugins.name: lowy
plugins.description: Löwy's Method for larger systems: volatility-based decomposition, layered services, call chains, service wiring, verified multi-agent audits, and fitness tests. Installs dmf as a dependency.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Multi-agent development workflows on Löwy's Method and DMF: a feature plan format, and a plan review where one agent writes, blind Löwy, call-chain, DMF and delivery reviewers review, skeptics verify, a judge rules, and the writer revises. Installs lowy and dmf as dependencies.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: A project-local skill that drives the real app the way a user does and keeps the proof: launch, health check, drive, evidence and cleanup, with a map of the app's user-facing features, proven end to end before handover and kept in step with the app. Recipes for web UIs, CLIs, HTTP services, .NET desktop apps that draw with their own renderer, and Unity.

plugins.name: house-rules
plugins.description: Four writing rules held at the tool call: no Claude attribution in commits or pull requests, no em dash in anything written, one full sentence per line of Markdown, and no file written from a shell heredoc or here-string.

plugins.name: workstation
plugins.description: The setup for every machine: installs and enables context7 and serena from Anthropic's official marketplace, sets the cc-resources status line when user settings have none, and allows the reads and writes the cc-resources workflows need.
